review: All required facts are present and nothing overflows, but the page looks like unstyled defaults: the nav links are jammed together, the desktop layout is a single stack of wide cards, and spacing is weak. It adds an invented 1 February standard-ticket start date and a 'Doors open' line, so it is not professional.

brief.summary:
Build the event page for Northwind DevDay 2027, a one-day developer conference.
Date: Thursday 18 March 2027, 09:00-18:00. Venue: The Foundry, 200 Mill Lane.
Three tracks: Web Platform, Data & AI, DevOps. Keynote: Priya Raman, "Shipping
without fear". 24 talks, 3 workshops.
Tickets: Early bird $149 until 31 January 2027, then $219. Student $59 with a valid ID.
Register at https://tickets.example.com/devday-2027.
Code of conduct at https://example.com/devday/conduct.
